transitions.historical_text: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can return it to your hand.
transitions.modern_text: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can add it to your hand, also banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your Graveyard during your opponent's next End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Sinister Serpent" once per turn.
transitions.summary: Functional erratum: the effect gains a hard once-per-turn limit and a delayed self-banish - after returning the card you must banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your GY during your opponent's next End Phase. The pre-errata script (pre-errata/c511000818.lua) has neither: its Standby Phase TRIGGER_O carries no SetCountLimit and its operation only does Duel.SendtoHand, while the modern script adds e1:SetCountLimit(1,id) and registers the opponent's-End-Phase Duel.Remove effect on resolution.

review.notes: No goat variant exists for this card; the pre-errata variant is the baseline. Its cdb text ('During your Standby Phase, if there is a "Sinister Serpent" in your Graveyard: you can add this card from your Graveyard to your hand.') is not an exact copy of any lineage version - the packet scores it 0.7656 against v0 - it is a modernised paraphrase blending v0's 'if there is a "Sinister Serpent" in your Graveyard' condition with post-PSCT phrasing. Behaviourally it is v0/v1: optional, unlimited, no banish. Recorded as such rather than as a conflict, because the script unambiguously implements the pre-2015 effect. Trailing cosmetic rewordings after the erratum are not recorded as changes: v2 -> v3 (SBAD-EN037, 2019-05-30, Graveyard -> GY) and v3 -> v4 (SBC1-ENH09, 2023-08-24, 'add it' -> 'return it'); v4 is the pinned modern text.
